title: Same borrower and $700/mo nontaxable income; the source changes (Fannie, documented nontaxable status)
source: Round 9: income source x can/cannot gross up. Loan officers ask an income-calculator agent whether nontaxable income can be grossed up.

paraphrases:
can you calculate the qualifying income for my borrower? fannie mae conventional, running DU.

File: {file}{framing}

need the qualifying monthly income for DU on this one (fannie conventional). what do i use?

File: {file}{framing}

please run the income calc for this borrower, conventional fannie loan.

File: {file}{framing}
turns:
for the file, reply with one JSON object only, no other text:
{{"qualifying_monthly_income": <number: the total monthly income i should enter in DU today>, "gross_up": [{{"income": "<source>", "add_on_monthly": <number>}}] (empty list if no gross-up)}}

CMP-muni.docs_required: document that verifies nontaxable status (award letter, policy agreement, account statement, tax return, or other document that addresses nontaxable status); signed federal tax returns for the most recent two years, or account statements for the most recent 24 months; verification of ownership of the assets
CMP-muni.docs_not_required: continuance verification (unless assets will be depleted)

CMP-alimony.docs_required: document that verifies nontaxable status (award letter, policy agreement, account statement, tax return, or other document that addresses nontaxable status); divorce decree, separation agreement, other written legal agreement or court decree, or documentation of applicable state law (one); evidence of receipt for the most recent six months; documentation of three-year continuance; URLA disclosure and borrower request to consider the income

PUB-assist.docs_required: document that verifies nontaxable status (award letter, policy agreement, account statement, tax return, or other document that addresses nontaxable status); letters or exhibits from the paying agency stating amount, frequency and duration; evidence of at least one payment on or before the first payment due date; documentation of three-year continuance

DIS-va.docs_required: document that verifies nontaxable status (award letter, policy agreement, account statement, tax return, or other document that addresses nontaxable status); VA statement, award letter or benefit statement, bank statement, signed federal tax return, or IRS 1099 (one or more); evidence of at least one payment on or before the first payment due date
DIS-va.docs_not_required: minimum history of receipt; three-year continuance verification (VA long-term disability benefits)
